record.question: The advantage of using vulcanized rubber in drug packaging is that:
options: It can become biodegradable after 10 years
It improves the elasticity and strength
It can become water soluble during disposal
It requires less amount to additives
record.explanation: Answer B: It improves the elasticity and strength. Vulcanization improves rubber’s elasticity, strength, and durability by cross-linking polymer chains. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/science/vulcanization. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
